backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend defining Post, Comment, and UserProfile types with CRUD operations, access control, blob storage, and handle-based profile management including uniqueness enforcement.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old user profiles (with only a name field) into the new UserProfile shape with handle, displayName, bio, and profilePicture, and initializes a handle-to-principal map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features (profile page with Internet Identity, public user profile page, handle search on ExplorePage, PostCard author display) with associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and notable changes, serving as a build/documentation reference for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based light and dark mode design tokens (colors, radius, sidebar, charts) for the application theme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with the page title set to 'InstaV' and a root div that loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app with ThemeProvider (dark default), InternetIdentityProvider, React Query's QueryClientProvider, the TanStack RouterProvider, and a Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to gradient initials, supporting multiple sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with icons and labels for Home, Explore, ShortSport, Create, and Profile routes; hidden on the full-screen ShortSport page.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component that displays and allows submission of comments for a given post, with loading skeletons, relative timestamps, and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: Editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload, simulated recording toggle, per-track volume/mute controls, and track removal.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: Editor panel for configuring canvas aspect ratio, solid background colors, and gradient presets applied to the first clip in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: Renders the video editor preview canvas, drawing clip backgrounds, text layers, stickers, and visual effects (glitch, letterbox, vignette, film grain, etc.) based on the current editor state.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: Displays a scrollable timeline with a ruler, playhead, and video clip tracks, supporting scrubbing, clip removal, and adding blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: UI panel for toggling motion graphic effects (glitch, confetti, letterbox, etc.) on the video, showing a grid of toggleable effect buttons and a list of currently active effects.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: Panel for exporting and sharing a video clip, providing title/description fields, a video preview, and download/share action buttons.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: Panel for applying and fine-tuning video filter presets (moody, cinematic, noir, etc.) and individual filter controls like brightness, contrast, saturation, and vignette via sliders.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: Panel for browsing emoji sticker categories, adding stickers to the video at the current time, and editing selected sticker properties like size, rotation, and duration.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: React panel component for managing text layers in a video editor, supporting adding, selecting, editing, and removing text layers with controls for font, color, alignment, animation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: React panel component that displays a library of video transition effects and allows users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a sticky TopBar, scrollable main content area, and a BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single social post card with author info, media (image/video), like/comment/view actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: Sticky header bar showing the app title, current page title, and an Internet Identity sign-in/sign-out button with loading state.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a video post card with thumbnail, play button overlay, duration badge, like/bookmark/comment actions, and a follow button using mock data types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, handling both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) cases and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and context provider for Internet Identity authentication via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for user profiles, posts, and comments, providing typed query and mutation hooks for all major data operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, imports Google Fonts, and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including sidebar and chart variables.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces (Post, Comment, User, Message, Conversation) and exports arrays of mock users and posts with placeholder data for UI development.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind classes, and formatters for numbers (K/M), time (mm:ss), and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for media, caption entry, and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page defining shared types (Clip, TextLayer, StickerLayer, FilterSettings, etc.) and rendering a multi-panel UI with timeline, filters, effects, stickers, and export tools.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a debounced search input and tabs to browse/filter all posts or search users by handle, using query hooks for data fetching.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Feed page that fetches and lists all posts via `useGetAllPosts`, renders each as a PostCard, and opens a CommentsSheet when a post's comment button is clicked.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Displays a two-panel messaging UI with a conversation list and an active chat view, supporting sending new messages using mock conversation data.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Handles the authenticated user's own profile page, including login/logout via Internet Identity, profile creation/editing, and avatar upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: Full-screen short video feed page that filters video posts, supports mute toggle, optimistic like updates, and vertical navigation between videos.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Public profile page for viewing another user's profile and post grid by handle or principal, with a not-found state and comments sheet integration.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all app routes (feed, explore, editor, profile, shorts, create, user profiles) wrapped in a shared Layout component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch CSS variables), border radii, shadows, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of a social media app project, including version, architectural notes, existing implemented features (profile setup, public profiles, user search, feed author display), and pending new feature requests.
